preamble: Lowering of the nucleus of the diphthong [ui] to [oi] (written -uy > -oy). It is documented in Tagalog and neighbouring Central Philippine languages, where final-syllable Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *-uy surfaces as -oy [oj] (PMP *babuy > baboy 'pig'). Clear cases outside the Philippines were not found.

examples.note: Inherited via Proto-Philippine *babuy; the same -oy appears in Cebuano, Hiligaynon, Waray-Waray, Central Bikol and Aklanon baboy.
Same final *-uy > -oy; Wiktionary notes the word may be a loan from a neighbouring Philippine language, but the lowering itself is regular in the area.
